rationale.selected_because: The active objective is to complete the authorized front-door lock work. The latest tenant update says Dorian was expected that day after 10:00, but attendance and repair or replacement are unconfirmed. Contact Dorian directly for the actual outcome and any firm return appointment; meanwhile establish whether the worsening lock can still be secured. The tenant also raised three separate concerns whose handling and ownership the agency could not confirm, so request a property-manager review for each rather than assume they are already assigned.

actions.question: Please confirm whether you attended the property as expected today and, if so, what work was completed and the lock's outcome. If you did not attend or the work remains incomplete, please confirm the next visit date and time.

Given your report that the lock is now worse than before, can you currently lock the front door securely and close it properly? Please tell us if either is no longer possible so we can assess the urgency of the outstanding lock work.
